quote: Blessed be God, at the end of the last year I was in very good health, without any sense of my old pain, but upon taking of cold.
source: Samuel Pepys, The Diary of Samuel Pepys, the opening entry, January 1659/60, vol. I (ed. Henry B. Wheatley, George Bell, 1893)

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg eBook #4125, the Wheatley text (George Bell and Sons, 1893), read directly
evidence.edition: The Diary of Samuel Pepys, ed. Henry B. Wheatley, vol. I (George Bell and Sons, 1893)
evidence.locator: January 1659-1660, the first sentence of the diary

reason: The sentence is the first of the diary in Wheatley, word for word and comma for comma; Wheatley's note explains the old pain as the stone he was cut for in 1658. Pepys is at zero of three, not banned, nothing shipped.
